calculation.description: Ranks assets higher when their trailing three-session return is more negative, normalized by 20-session realized volatility and a small stabilizer. The signal uses only information available at the completed session.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC was positive across 2020-2022 (0.046682; 765 dates), 2023-2024 (0.025609; 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (0.035387; 574 dates). Cross-section uses all 15 tradable benchmark instruments with at least 8 valid names per date; uncertainty remains material given the small universe.
